'''Rod Latham Sheer Destruction''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds133.htm Sheer Destruction], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041027103524/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds133.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Rod Latham]]
